main_result: For 0<q<p<∞ and a positive finite Borel measure on the unit disk, the embedding A^p→L^q(μ) is bounded exactly when the fixed-radius pseudohyperbolic disk mass divided by its normalized area lies in L^{p/(p−q)}.

selection_reason: Adjacent Bergman-space antecedent for the ambient weighted Mellin trace criterion. The strip transfer uses further inputs. The article supplies neither a physically constrained counterexample nor a signed endpoint result.
